title: Compatibility after fixing free literals
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ Boolean coordinates, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction compatible with $T$. For $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, suppose that at every position corresponding to a literal whose coordinate is free under $\rho$, the relative bit of $x$ is $0$. Fix all such free literal coordinates to the signs encoded by $x$. The resulting coordinate restriction remains compatible with $T$.
hypotheses_covered: The relative bit is $0$ at every free literal position
